verification_note: Full real-execution verification, same method as the P1 vertical-slice worked example: cloned the repository at the exact pinned source_revision, created an isolated venv (python -m venv), ran `pip install .` against the source checkout (the README's own documented install path -- this package is not published to PyPI, confirmed independently below), and executed real code against every encoding/rendering/error-path claim this session had time to check.

facts.claim: The package is not yet published to PyPI. Install it from a source checkout.
facts.evidence: curl https://pypi.org/pypi/aspose-barcode-foss/json -> HTTP 404. `pip install .` against the cloned source_revision succeeded and is the only viable install path, exactly as the README documents.

facts.claim: Distribution name aspose-barcode-foss, import package aspose_barcode_foss, requires Python 3.12+, requires Pillow >=10.1.0 as the one real runtime dependency
facts.evidence: pyproject.toml: name = "aspose-barcode-foss", requires-python = ">=3.12", dependencies = ["Pillow>=10.1.0"] -- exact match. `import aspose_barcode_foss` succeeded after installing into the venv.

facts.claim: Ships a py.typed marker for full type-checker support
facts.evidence: Reproduced live: os.path.exists(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(aspose_barcode_foss.__file__), "py.typed")) == True in the installed venv.

facts.claim: Quick Start (code128) and generate()/qr()/code39()/code39ext() all produce real SVG/PNG output
facts.evidence: Reproduced live: code128("Hello-World").to_svg() -> real 2228-byte SVG string starting '<svg xmlns=...'; .to_png() -> real 793-byte PNG with the correct magic bytes (b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'). generate("qr", "https://example.com").to_png() -> 514-byte PNG. qr("PAYLOAD", encode=QrOptions(error_correction_level=QrErrorCorrectionLevel.H, encoding_mode=QrEncodeMode.AUTO)) -> real SVG. code39("ABC-123", encode=Code39Options(add_check_digit=True)) -> real SVG. code39ext("abc_123!") -> real SVG.

facts.claim: EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, and UPC-E retail barcodes support automatic check-digit computation or explicit check-digit validation via allow_check_digit_input
facts.evidence: Reproduced live: ean13("123456789012"), ean8("1234567"), upca("12345678901") all produced real SVG output with automatic check-digit computation (11/7/11-digit inputs, one digit short of the full symbol, consistent with auto-computed check digits). upce("042100005264", encode=UpceOptions(allow_check_digit_input=True)) succeeded (1841-byte SVG) with a full 12-digit input including an explicit check digit; the same call without allow_check_digit_input=True correctly raised InvalidInputError('12-digit input requires allow_check_digit_input=True') -- confirms both code paths the README describes.

facts.claim: RenderOptions controls scale, DPI, module width/height, and a direct Renderer subclass (SvgRenderer) can be passed to Barcode.render()
facts.evidence: Reproduced live: code128(...).to_svg(options=RenderOptions(scale=2.0, show_text=True)) and .to_png(options=RenderOptions(dpi=300, module_width=3.0)) both succeeded. SvgRenderer() passed directly to barcode.render(renderer, options=RenderOptions(scale=3.0)) returned a RenderedArtifact with real .data content.

facts.claim: PDF rendering is not implemented -- Barcode.to_pdf() and PdfRenderer.render() both raise NotImplementedError. SVG and PNG rendering are implemented for every symbology.
facts.evidence: Reproduced live: barcode.to_pdf() raised NotImplementedError. Read src/aspose_barcode_foss/_internal/renderers/pdf.py directly: PdfRenderer.render() unconditionally 'raise NotImplementedError' with no implementation. SVG/PNG confirmed working for every symbology tested above (Code128, Code39, Code39Ext, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, QR).

facts.claim: ECI (Extended Channel Interpretation) normalization and validation (EciHelper.normalize/.validate) are not implemented in this FOSS build
facts.evidence: Read src/aspose_barcode_foss/_internal/standards/eci.py directly: EciHelper.normalize() and .validate() both unconditionally 'raise NotImplementedError' with no implementation body.

facts.claim: GS1 data parsing and validation (Gs1Helper.parse/.validate) are not implemented in this FOSS build
facts.evidence: Read src/aspose_barcode_foss/_internal/standards/gs1.py directly: Gs1Helper.parse() and .validate() both unconditionally 'raise NotImplementedError' with no implementation body.

facts.claim: This library only generates (encodes) barcodes -- it does not read or decode existing barcode images for any symbology
facts.evidence: Reproduced live: the installed package's top-level module exposes no `decode`/`read` function (hasattr checks both False); the only public entry points are the encoding helpers and generate().
